rituals.title: NO-SEQUEL
rituals.mission: Allow thought one but deny it a sequel.
rituals.rule: The first thought is permitted in full.

rituals.twist: A genuinely unrelated thought may enter.
rituals.win: The original thought ends without becoming a chain.
rituals.mind_bend: The first thought and its explanatory sequel are separate events; rumination begins in what gets added after the thought is already complete.

rituals.title: QUEUE MASTER

rituals.rule: Only one item can occupy the front slot.

rituals.twist: After three beats, move the front ticket to the back without solving it.
rituals.win: Competition becomes an orderly sequence rather than a pile-up.
rituals.mind_bend: Mental overload can come from simultaneous competition, not sheer quantity; sequencing the arrivals changes the pressure without deleting any of them.

rituals.title: MONTY SWITCH

rituals.rule: The host always reveals a losing door you did not choose.

rituals.win: Switching captures the original probability carried by the two unchosen doors and wins with probability 2/3.
rituals.mind_bend: When the host is forced to reveal a losing door, the original two-thirds probability does not vanish; it concentrates on the remaining unchosen door, making switching rational.
